summary.zh-CN: 聚焦收藏区体验，补齐视图切换与交互细节，收藏管理更清晰顺手。
summary.en-US: Focused on favorites/workbench experience with view switching and interaction refinements for clearer, smoother collection management.

zh-CN: 收藏区新增视图切换能力，支持按不同浏览偏好切换展示方式。
继续优化收藏栏结构与操作路径，常用动作更集中、反馈更直接。
完善收藏项的交互处理细节，减少状态切换时的困惑与误触。
同步优化相关历史流文件展示细节，收藏与历史协同更顺滑。
en-US: Added view switching in the favorites/workbench area for different browsing preferences.
Further refined favorites panel structure and action flow for clearer, faster operations.
Improved favorite-item interaction handling to reduce confusion and mis-taps during state changes.
Polished related history-file presentation details for smoother flow between history and favorites.

summary.zh-CN: 新增可选的截图识别入口，并补齐拖动成文件、多选与小屏编辑增强，整体更稳更顺手。
summary.en-US: Added an optional Smart Copy entry plus drag-to-file, multi-select, and small-screen editing enhancements for a cleaner, more reliable workflow.

zh-CN: 设置中新增“显示截图识别按钮”开关，默认关闭，主界面更简洁。
开启后会在设置页给出触发位置提示，明确可从标题栏左侧入口启动。
截图识别入口图标升级为更直观的扫描样式，降低识别路径理解成本。
智能复制在 Windows 下改为系统 Native OCR 优先，云端/当前配置作为失败兜底。
即使云端 OCR 短暂异常，也能优先依赖本地 OCR 保证可用性。
新增“拖动文字生成文件”能力，可将文本内容直接拖出为文件用于跨应用交付。
多选流程持续优化，批量操作路径更清晰，组合处理更高效。
小屏幕下编辑区按钮可用性增强，避免窄窗场景按钮拥挤或难以点击。
en-US: Added a "Show Smart Copy Button" setting and turned it off by default to keep the main UI cleaner.
When enabled, Settings now shows a clear hint for where to trigger Smart Copy from the title bar.
Updated the Smart Copy entry icon to a more intuitive scan-style visual.
On Windows, Smart Copy now prioritizes native OCR first, with configured/cloud OCR as fallback.
If cloud OCR is temporarily unavailable, local OCR still keeps Smart Copy usable.
Added drag-to-file for text so clipboard content can be dragged out directly as a file across apps.
Further refined multi-select flows with clearer batch actions and more efficient combined operations.
Improved edit-action buttons on small screens to avoid cramped layouts and preserve tap targets.

summary.zh-CN: 新增历史右键菜单与升级提示板，并优化工作区检索链路与编辑体验。
summary.en-US: Added a richer history context menu and in-app release notes, with better workspace search/favorites coverage and editing flow.

zh-CN: 新增历史卡片右键菜单，支持复制/纯文本复制、置顶、编辑备注标签、删除等快捷操作。
多选场景加入右键批量动作（合并复制、批量删除二次确认），批处理效率更高。
新增版本更新提示板：升级后自动展示本次更新，并可一键跳转完整更新日志。
优化编辑弹窗交互与视觉细节，快速新增、保存反馈与操作路径更顺滑。
优化工作区数据检索：搜索与收藏筛选走后端过滤，低内存窗口下结果更完整、更稳定。
en-US: Added a context menu for history cards with quick actions for copy/copy as plain text, pin, note/tag editing, and delete.
Extended right-click support to multi-select actions, including merged copy and guarded batch delete confirmation.
Introduced an in-app What's New panel that appears after upgrades and links directly to the full changelog.
Refined edit modal interactions and visual details to make quick add, save feedback, and editing flows smoother.
Improved workspace retrieval: search and favorites now use backend filtering for more complete and stable results under low-memory windows.

summary.zh-CN: 优化右键菜单与窗口交互，日常操作更顺手。
summary.en-US: Refined context-menu and window interactions for smoother daily workflows.

zh-CN: 新增并优化右键菜单设计，常用操作更直观
增加窗口置顶能力，便于跨应用快速粘贴
改进快速预览与面板交互，提升整体易用性
en-US: Redesigned and refined the context menu for clearer common actions.
Added always-on-top support for faster cross-app copy/paste workflows.
Improved quick preview and panel interactions for better usability.
